findings.reason: a plan that adds a subsystem must cite the mechanism it extends; had the search been run it would have extended the owner instead of forking the placement convention.
findings.text: `default_forward_compilation_cache_root` was authored for §1 as a new placement resolver, but no prior-art search of Nova's existing cache-placement machinery is recorded; nova/jax/config.py:103 already owns `default_persistent_compilation_cache_root` and nova/jax/config.py:153 `configure_persistent_compilation_cache`, which versions the cache directory by runtime and topology, so the design rebuilt a mechanism that existed.

findings.reason: the design should extend nova/jax/config.py (one root, one variable) rather than add a parallel placement path, which the rubric measures as the recurring duplicate and which drifts silently because the two variables disagree.
findings.text: a second compilation-cache root resolver sits beside the owner: this one reads `NOVA_FORWARD_COMPILATION_CACHE_ROOT` and defaults to `~/.cache/nova/forward-compilation-cache/user-<uid>/host-<hostname>`, while nova/jax/config.py:103 reads `NOVA_COMPILATION_CACHE_ROOT` and defaults to `~/.cache`; forward.py:2371 `_configure_solve_compilation_cache` then selects between `jax.config.jax_compilation_cache_dir` and this local resolver, so one concept has two owners and two environment variables. The H200 prewarm lane exports only the owner's variable (scripts/h200_test_lane/run.sh:46, prewarm.sh:53), so a launch pinned that way is not read by the forward resolver.

findings.reason: the honest change is to extend the existing keyword path's default resolution to the seam's contract, or state in the done-when when the keyword input is retired; unbounded coexistence means a route can silently resolve defaults through the path the plan did not migrate.
findings.text: `ForwardProfile.solve` accepts either a `ForwardSolveRequest` or ~13 solve keywords, forbids mixing them, and dispatches to `_solve_request` or to `_resolve_solve_defaults`; the request path is a new input surface laid over the keyword machinery it duplicates, and the plan's §2 migration and done-when list no step that deletes the keyword path, leaving two default-resolution paths over the same version-keyed policy.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — ForwardSolveRequest, ForwardSolvePolicy and ForwardSolveReceipt hide version-keyed default resolution, six-route keyword translation (ForwardSolvePolicy.kernel_options) and receipt provenance behind three types.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan re-implements the JAX compilation-cache root resolution rather than extending its owner in nova/jax/config.py.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the §1 design added a compilation-cache path resolver in nova/equilibrium/solve_request.py without checking nova/jax/config.py, which already owns the persistent JAX compilation cache root and directory versioning.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — ForwardProfile.solve keeps a full keyword input path beside the ForwardSolveRequest path, each resolving its own policy, and the plan states no done-when that retires the keyword path.
